title: The main street in Saigon
description: A broad, tree-lined boulevard in low sun, closed at its far end by an ornate building with a central tower. In the foreground a man with a camera at his chest walks hand in hand with a small girl in a pink dress and sun hat; behind them a woman in a pale blue áo dài, a woman in red, two men in white shirts and a man in a conical hat cross the open pavement. Taxis and sedans are parked along the left under shop signs, one ending …O THANH, and flower stalls stand around a traffic island at right. "Location: the main street in Saigon."
researchNotes: Larry's comment of 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0040-c18416126.json) names the city and calls this its main street, without naming the street. The survey read the building at the far end as the city hall at the head of Nguyễn Huệ Boulevard; that is a machine reading and is not adopted here. If it is right, this is the boulevard of his 'street of flowers, parallel to Tudo' in VN-0068, and the flower stalls at right fit; the identification is not made from his words.
